usage: aidebug [-h] [--workspace WORKSPACE] [--timeout TIMEOUT]
               {launch,break,exceptions,continue,pause,step,inspect,variables,status,output,stop,note,view} ...

Local Python, JS/TS, and Rust debugger. Every command prints JSON.

positional arguments:
  {launch,break,exceptions,continue,pause,step,inspect,variables,status,output,stop,note,view}
    launch              launch a script, executable, or local browser URL
    break               add or remove breakpoints
    pause               request a stop in the running target
    note                record an explanation alongside debugger observations
    view                start or locate the local live/replay viewer

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --workspace WORKSPACE
                        session workspace, default: current directory
  --timeout TIMEOUT     command deadline in seconds, 0.01 to 60

Agent debugging loop (run in the target project, or add --workspace PATH):
  aidebug view --open
  aidebug launch --module --run --breakpoint pricing.py:6 pytest -- -q test_checkout.py
  aidebug inspect
  aidebug inspect --frame FRAME_HANDLE
  aidebug variables VALUE_HANDLE
  aidebug note "Describe the observed values and suspected cause."
  aidebug step over
  aidebug continue
  aidebug output
  aidebug stop

Replace the test and breakpoint with your project paths. For a script, use
launch script.py; for unittest, use launch --module unittest -- -q test_module.
Pytest must be installed in the target interpreter. Test runners catch assertions;
